name: notion-api
description: Notion via the official API: search, pages and properties, database (data source) queries, page content and comments

nodes.title: Search
nodes.description: Search the pages and data sources shared with the integration by title, newest edits first by default.

query.description: Text to find in titles; omit to list everything shared with the integration

object_type.description: Only pages or only data sources (database tables)

limit.description: Results per page (1-100, Notion's default is 100)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get page
nodes.description: Get a Notion page's properties, parent, URL and trash status (not its content; use get_block_children for that).

page_id.description: Page id (with or without dashes) or the page's Notion URL

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get page property
nodes.description: Get one property of a page in full, paginated for long titles/rich text, relations and people (get_page truncates them at 25 items).

page_id.description: Page id (with or without dashes) or the page's Notion URL

property_name.description: Property name, instead of property_id (costs one extra request)

limit.description: Results per page (1-100, Notion's default is 100)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Create page
nodes.description: Create a page in a database (data source) or under a page, with properties as a simple {name: value} map and/or Notion JSON, and optional plain-text paragraphs. Never retried after an unknown outcome.

data_source_id.description: Data source id (a database's table; from get_database `data_sources` or search with object_type data_source)

database_id.description: Database id or URL; used when the database has exactly one data source (otherwise pass data_source_id)

parent_page_id.description: Parent page id or URL; such a page only has a title: values {"title": "..."}

values.description: Simple {"Property name": value} map for title, rich_text, number (number or plain decimal string), select, multi_select (array or comma-separated string), status, date (ISO string or {start, end, time_zone}), checkbox, url, email, phone_number; null clears (a checkbox becomes false) and "" clears select, multi_select, url, email and phone_number

properties.description: Property values as Notion JSON (any type); wins over `values` for the same name. Agents may set people properties only when NOTION_TOOL_ALLOW_PEOPLE=1

paragraphs.description: Plain-text paragraphs for the page body (at most 100)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Update page properties
nodes.description: Update some properties of a page; others are left unchanged. Takes a simple {name: value} map and/or Notion JSON.

page_id.description: Page id (with or without dashes) or the page's Notion URL

values.description: Simple {"Property name": value} map for title, rich_text, number (number or plain decimal string), select, multi_select (array or comma-separated string), status, date (ISO string or {start, end, time_zone}), checkbox, url, email, phone_number; null clears (a checkbox becomes false) and "" clears select, multi_select, url, email and phone_number

properties.description: Property values as Notion JSON (any type); wins over `values` for the same name. Agents may set people properties only when NOTION_TOOL_ALLOW_PEOPLE=1

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Archive page
nodes.description: Move a page to the Notion trash (in_trash). Reversible with restore_page.

page_id.description: Page id (with or without dashes) or the page's Notion URL

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Restore page
nodes.description: Restore a page from the Notion trash.

page_id.description: Page id (with or without dashes) or the page's Notion URL

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get database
nodes.description: Get a Notion database: title, parent and its `data_sources` (id and name of each table).

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get data source
nodes.description: Get a Notion data source (a database table) with its property schema: names, types and select options.

data_source_id.description: Data source id (a database's table; from get_database `data_sources` or search with object_type data_source)

database_id.description: Database id or URL; used when the database has exactly one data source (otherwise pass data_source_id)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Query database
nodes.description: Query the pages of a Notion database (its data source) with an optional Notion filter and sorts, one page of results at a time.

data_source_id.description: Data source id (a database's table; from get_database `data_sources` or search with object_type data_source)

database_id.description: Database id or URL; used when the database has exactly one data source (otherwise pass data_source_id)

limit.description: Results per page (1-100, Notion's default is 100)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get block children
nodes.description: Read the content of a page or block: its child blocks (paragraphs, headings, lists, ...), one page at a time.

block_id.description: Block id, or a page id/URL (a page is a block)

limit.description: Results per page (1-100, Notion's default is 100)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Append paragraphs
nodes.description: Append plain-text paragraphs (at most 100 per call, 400000 characters in total) to a page or block, at the end by default. Never retried after an unknown outcome.

block_id.description: Block id, or a page id/URL (a page is a block)

paragraphs.description: One string per paragraph; long text is split into 2000-character pieces

after_block_id.description: Insert after this child block instead of at the end

at_start.description: Insert at the start instead of at the end

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Add comment
nodes.description: Add a plain-text comment to a page, a block or an existing discussion thread. Never retried after an unknown outcome.

page_id.description: Comment on this page (id or URL)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Notion API request
nodes.description: Call any Notion API endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/users/me". Only the API's own host is allowed.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/users/me"

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
